build_actor_network: build an Actor MLP network with an encoder trunk and Gaussian policy for SAC
build_critic_network: build a Critic network with two Q-functions for twin-Q value estimation in SAC
build_qfunction: build a QFunction MLP that takes concatenated observations and actions to predict Q-values
run_gaussian_logprob: run gaussian_logprob to compute the log probability of noise under a Gaussian distribution
run_squash_function: run the squash function to apply tanh squashing with log-probability correction for SAC
